state.question: Has Gate Parcel's operating change resolved the question about parcel first attempt? Focus on: September first-attempt delivery success and the change from August using attempted parcels as the denominator.
state.conclusion: Gate extended its evening delivery windows.
state.gap: September first-attempt delivery success and the change from August using attempted parcels as the denominator.

candidates.title: Gate Parcel: the latest field dispatch
candidates.abstract: I set out the case for Gate Parcel's strategy in parcel first attempt, using incentives and managerial judgement to project the next stage.

candidates.title: Gate Parcel: what the announcement changes
candidates.abstract: Our reporting desk follows Gate Parcel, drawing on an independent correspondent's account of september first-attempt delivery success and the change from August using attempted parcels as the denominator.

candidates.title: Gate Parcel: the measurement desk
candidates.abstract: An edited digest of Yuna Ward's Dispatch's dispatch on Gate Parcel, retaining its reported comparison and attribution.

candidates.title: Gate Parcel: the weekly notebook
candidates.abstract: Gate delivery scan log supports a dated assessment of september first-attempt delivery success and the change from August using attempted parcels as the denominator.

candidates.title: Gate Parcel: the strategic argument
candidates.abstract: A commentary revisiting Gate Parcel's operating announcement, carrying the same factual account as the public record.

candidates.title: Gate Parcel: the operating record
candidates.abstract: Gate Parcel features in a field guide to parcel first attempt. The worked example draws on a separate setting: an education blog covers first attempts at a parcel-wrapping craft task.
